uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Increases Attack by 10% for 5s when afflicted by any debuff. Increases Attack when afflicted by a status condition.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits. This boosted attack also decreases the movement speed of enemies by 50% for 1s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits. This boosted attack also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits. This boosted attack also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.
Machamp attacks in a straight line dealing damage to enemies hit. Attack opposing Pokémon with a sharp chop.

Machamp unleashes a barrage of blows in a targeted direction for 1s, hitting multiple times and finishing with a single large strike. Machamp is unstoppable for the duration and can move while using Close Combat. Unleash a series of punches in the designated direction, dealing increased damage with the last punch. The user can move while using this move and becomes immune to hindrances.
Deals 25% additional damage if the target is affected by a status condition. Deals increased damage to enemies that are afflicted by a status condition.

Machamp dashes forward, dealing damage to enemies hit. Cross Chop may critically hit and has a 5% higher Critical-Hit Rate. Cross Chop further increases Critical-Hit Rate by 5% for 3s on hit. Has the user deliver a double chop with forearms crossed while dashing forward. This increases the user's critical-hit rate.
Machamp’s auto attacks increases Atk by 3 per target hit, permanently stacking up to 40 times. Increases Attack with each basic attack, up to a set max.

Machop buffs themselves for 3s becoming unstoppable, increasing attack by 15%, attack speed by 40% and movement speed by 30% inititally, diminishing gradually every 1s. Machop's next attack is boosted. Become immune to hindrances for a short time. Increases movement speed, basic attack speed, and Attack. The next basic attack also becomes a boosted attack.

Machamp jumps to target location, becoming unstoppable for 0.5s, stunning enemies hit for 0.5s, slowing them by 40% for 3s, and dealing damage four times in quick succession to the landing radius. Machamp’s Attack is increased by 15% for 5s and gains bonus movement speed of 40% diminishing by 20% over 3s when using Dynamic Punch. Machamp’s next auto attack is boosted. Jump to the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act when it hits. After using this move, the user becomes immune to hindrances, their movement speed and basic attack speed is increased. The next basic attack also becomes a boosted attack.
Further increases movement speed by 30%, Attack bonus by 5%, and slow by 20%. Increased Attack and movement speed.

Machamp becomes unstoppable for 5s and gains 70% increased movement speed (diminishing every 1s by 20%) or until the next auto attack. Machamp’s next auto attack during submission is enhanced, hitting twice and slamming the target down behind Machamp. If this attack hits, Machamp also gains 5% increased Critical-Hit Rate and 40% Attack Speed for 3s. Increases movement speed and become immune to hindrances. When the next basic attack hits, the attack deals increased damage and slams the enemy onto the ground, leaving it unable to act. Once this move ends, the user's critical-hit rate and basic attack speed are increased for a short time.
Further increases Critical-Hit Rate by 5% and Attack Speed by 10%. Increased critical-hit rate and basic attack speed.

Machamp gains increased movement speed by 10%, Attack by 25%, Defense by 300, and Sp. Defense by 300 for 8s before unleashing an unstoppable combo attack that continuously shoves enemies in the area of effect. Increases Machamp's movement speed by 5%, Attack by 30%, Defense by 200, and Sp. Defense by 200 for 10s. If used again, unleash a combo attack, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and shoving them. The final blow deals double the damage of the previous hits.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
